authorization.scope: ONE real Inventory paid test via PayPal

displayed_fees.interpretation: No separate buyer-fee line observed in Payhip; PayPal final amount/FX/fees not verified because PayPal was not activated. Do not assume absence of fees.

blocker: Owner confirms merchant PayPal is their only PayPal account; no separate buyer PayPal exists. Original PayPal-only test cannot proceed as scoped.
smallest_owner_action: No further payment-route confirmation requested. Leave paid processing unverified; no self-payment, new account, third-party payer, method switch or charge.

same_account_payment_block.finding: PayPal documents CANNOT_PAY_SELF for a payment whose initiating and receiving account are the same. Different checkout email alone does not prove separate PayPal payer identity.

account_types.finding: PayPal permits one personal plus one business account generally; this is not proof that an eligible separate payer/funding method exists here. No account creation/switch requested.

buyer_fee.published_rule: No purchase fee when currency conversion is not involved.

seller_processor_fee.published_standard_domestic_commercial_r: 2.90% + CA$0.30 fixed fee for CAD received

refund.finding: Sent refunds cannot be cancelled; original receiving fees are not returned. No refund is authorized or initiated.
